texts.orig: The selection  a value  of N  for  an object involves a tradeoff. If  N is  too  small,  there  tends  to  be  lot  of  aliasing  and system  performance  suffers  due  to false rollbacks. If  N is  too large,  a  great  deal  of  memory  is  used  for  marking  bits  which can cause cache performance to Suffer. In one  embodiment of the  present invention,  N=8. In  another embodiment, N=16.

texts.orig: FIG. 13 illustrates how a marking bit  number can be determined  from  a  field number  or  an  array element  number in accordance with  an  embodiment  of  the present  invention. The system starts will a field number or an array element number 1302. In the case of a field  number, the system performs a modulo operation by masking off all but the lower order three bits of field number 1302 to produce a three  bit  index  (1,0,0)  that  specifies  a  marking  bit. In  the  case of  an array index, he system performs a division operation by  shifting array element  number  1302  until only the three most  significant bits (0,1,1) remain.
